visualReview.scope: Inspected English language-selection and Simplified Chinese ready-page fixture captures at default DPI and System dark theme. Earlier complete tour visual review retains its original candidate hash in introduction-validation.json.

retainedFailures.reason: Windows PowerShell interpreted UTF-8 Chinese assertions without a BOM as ANSI. Both fixture scripts now have a UTF-8 BOM; the fresh final runs above passed unchanged browser binaries.
Restricted runner denied Node test subprocess creation with spawn EPERM; ordinary-user run passed all 32 bootstrap/pointer checks.

limits: Live UI checks use native messages; physical keyboard/mouse, multi-monitor/DPI, light-theme and high-contrast introduction acceptance remain manual
Protected authentication, autofill, crash persistence and lifecycle suites were not repeated on alpha.15; their earlier records remain bound to their original hashes
No production installer upgrade was installed over the user copy
Documentation checks establish the fixed navigation URL, not remote GitHub content availability
Unsigned hashes establish byte integrity, not publisher identity
privacy: Only disposable profiles, synthetic pages and isolated installer identities were used; no tokens, private state, raw browsing logs or screenshots are included
